name: 3.1.Verify Page redirections Under Footer from HompePage
fullName: 3.1.Verify Page redirections Under Footer from HompePage
description:
Verify that the shared footer navigation as rendered on the Homepage (homepage) loads successfully and every footer link (`footer.footer-main a`) resolves without a 404 or 500 error, with correct trailing slashes on internal links.

Expected: The shared footer navigation as rendered on the Homepage should load successfully (HTTP 200) and every in-page link in scope should resolve to a valid destination — no broken (404) or server-error (500) links, and internal links should end with a trailing slash.
